about: Computed by ikigai-core 0.2.7 and ikigai-vocab 0.2.7 (ActionSpec::contract_iri, ikigai_vocab::to_turtle; ledger #2512, #2557) for contracts with inputs a named request fixes (ArgSpec::fixed_to). Core's shared contract_vectors.json carries no such case yet; when it does, these move there. fixed/none is fixed/one without the fix: it fixes nothing, so it keeps the v1 form.
